context: A screenshot of ghent-live, a 3D map of the historic centre of Ghent (Belgium) rendered in a web browser, shown on a projector during a talk. The camera stands at eye height on a bridge over the river Leie (the Sint-Michielsbrug) and looks east toward the city's towers.

checks.name: three_towers
checks.instructions: Three towers stand in a row.

checks.name: eye_level
checks.instructions: The view is from street level, at about eye height, looking across the city rather than down on it from the air.

checks.name: tower_labels
checks.instructions: Name labels such as 'Sint-Niklaas', 'Belfort' and 'Sint-Baafs' mark the towers.
